summary: Iteration 32 — Drill Export PDF + CRM Sync Cron tested end-to-end. Backend 10/10 pytest cases green: PDF endpoint returns application/pdf with valid %PDF- magic + 64-char hex X-Drill-Signature header, bogus series → 400, q filter yields distinct signature, receipt persisted and lookupable via GET /verify-drill/{sig}, POST /verify-drill returns authentic:true on match and authentic:false on tamper, unknown sig → {receipt_found:false, receipt:null}. CRM sync: employer GET /sync-log returns items[]+count, POST /sync-now with no CRM tokens returns {connections:0,pushed:0,skipped:0,failed:0}, talent → 403. Admin GET /admin/scheduler exposes job id='nightly_crm_sync'. Frontend: /trust drill drawer renders [data-testid='drill-download-pdf'] anchor with correct href (/api/trust/timeseries/details/pdf?series=refs), target=_blank, and q propagates into href (…&q=xyz) as user types in the search box. /integrations as employer with zero CRM connections correctly hides both crm-sync-now and crm-sync-log (gated branch validated).
critical_code_review_comments: The presence branch of crm-sync-now (with a live CRM connection) is only validated at API level in this iteration because the test env has no HubSpot/Salesforce tokens — the main agent should confirm the rendered UI once real tokens are configured. Not a bug per the acceptance criteria (which explicitly says 'validate the hide branch').

_render_drill_pdf embeds PUBLIC_BASE_URL in the QR verify URL — env var is currently unset, so the QR encodes just '/api/trust/verify-drill/{sig}' (relative). Cosmetic-only; scanners will not resolve without a host. Consider defaulting to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or the request base.
_sync_shortlists_to_crm advances last_sync_at watermark even when all rows fail — retry story relies solely on /sync-log inspection. Acceptable per design comment but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: None — PDF endpoint reused existing 30-day trust data; drill_receipts collection was populated implicitly by the tests (safe, additive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 32 additions live at: GET /api/trust/timeseries/details/pdf (query: series, q), POST /api/trust/verify-drill (body: signature,series,ts,items), GET /api/trust/verify-drill/{signature}, POST /api/integrations/crm/sync-now (employer), GET /api/integrations/crm/sync-log, and APScheduler job 'nightly_crm_sync' at 02:00 UTC visible in GET /api/admin/scheduler. Frontend testids: 'drill-download-pdf' (anchor in /trust drill modal), 'crm-sync-now' + 'crm-sync-log' (only rendered on /integrations when employer has ≥1 CRM connection). DRILL_SIGN_SECRET env var not set — deterministic constant salt fallback in use, which is what verify-drill tamper tests depend on.
